topic: Data aggregation and dashboard visibility issues
summary_markdown:
The discussion centered on data processing issues for virtual sensors. Initial concerns were raised about new data not appearing on the dashboard.

It was determined that a full recalculation of historical data was necessary, as previous processes had only added new records. The process failed initially due to memory constraints when attempting to run over the entire period. It was advised to re-run the aggregation in smaller date ranges (e.g., month by month).

Eventually, an aggregation job was successfully launched and tested for a couple of months, with September data being available for checking on the dashboard.
decisions: The data needs to be re-aggregated using the templates/scripted process.
Aggregation must be run in smaller date ranges (e.g., monthly) instead of attempting the entire historical period at once.
action_items: Someone needs to check the dashboard for visibility after the aggregation runs.
The full data set requires continued processing across remaining months.
